Electrical wiring schematic for a muffle furnace, showing the power supply, heating elements, temperature-control components, and optional pyrometer connection.

- MUFFLE: contains two heating elements, each labeled 12 OHMS.
- PY50 TYPE K T/C: thermocouple connected to a terminal block. A note states “CUSTOMER-FURNISHED PYROMETER (IF USED) CONNECTS HERE.”
- CR19: #12-3 CORDSET with a 5-20P cap. The cap view identifies W, N, and G; a CASE GROUND connection is also shown.
- MS8 PILOT LIGHT: connected to the infinite control switch.
- SW5 INFINITE CONTROL SWITCH, 120V: terminals are labeled TOP, PL, L1, L2, H1, and H2.
- TF17: 30A RELAY, 120V COIL. Its coil terminals are marked 1 and 0; contact terminals are marked 2, 4, 6, and 8.
- Power wiring: L2 connects to H2 of the infinite control switch. H1 connects to terminal 8 of the relay. Terminal 6 connects to one end of the upper 12 OHMS element. Terminal 2 connects to the other end of that element and to one end of the lower 12 OHMS element. Terminal 4 connects to the other end of the lower element. Terminal 0 connects to L1.
- Pilot-light wiring: L1 connects to PL through a WH wire. L2 connects to the pilot light through a BLK wire.
- POWER REQ’TS: 120 VOLTS; 1 PHASE; 50/60 HERTZ; 20 AMPS; 2400 WATTS; MAX TEMP 1700° F.
- WIRE SIZES: NOTE: ALL WIRES TO BE TYPE SEW/SF2, #14 AWG MINIMUM UNLESS NOTED.
